findings.title: Independent full-certificate expiry oracle is not demonstrated
findings.description: The exact full_action_basis_denials_dc oracle requires source/runtime expiry denials and fresh post-lock time evidence; the owner-pipeline oracle also requires the finite minimum expiry. seed_source assigns the same end to admission freshness, fixture policy, registered runtime, engine and projection. The only consumer before/after expiry pair uses seconds=6 for that shared end. Its committed after_expiry witness reports 'attempt/request/manifest/epoch/stage basis changed or expired', so the common manifest guard rejects before _verify_full_progress and does not demonstrate the new S36/S37 minimum-expiry guard while current manifest and workflow authority remain valid. The PU fixture likewise gives every bound the same expiry. These tests cannot distinguish using the manifest deadline alone from propagating an earlier admitted-source deadline. Code inspection and an independent heterogeneous-deadline pure rerun support the implementation's minimum calculation, but they do not satisfy the required committed DC oracle.
findings.requested_change: Add task-owned real-PG cases with deliberately different valid bounds, including an admitted-source deadline earlier than the manifest/runtime/lease/root deadline. Produce both S36 rows and S37 through actual owners, assert the exact earliest persisted deadline, then exercise before/after the earlier bound with an observed bounded blocker and fresh post-lock time. Verify zero output/bookkeeping/stage/pointer effects and identify the full-resolution/full-validation denial reached with still-valid ingress/current manifest. Cover the named source/runtime expiry obligations without counting an unrelated earlier failure as their proof. Rerun every required check on the new tested revision and request fresh reviews.

findings.title: COMMIT_READY does not independently exercise all required current-state denials
findings.description: The packet explicitly requires real owners and actual COMMIT_READY to independently reject current manifest, attempt, fence and lease loss. The 30 preparation-denial cases exercise those conditions on ResolveEvidence, while the consumer selector list covers resolution_swap, foreign validation/resolution, runtime revocation, execution basis, epoch, revision, control, deadline and shared expiry only. There is no full COMMIT_READY current-manifest replacement, current-attempt mismatch, fence/takeover or lease-expiry case in the test file or raw final log. Reusing the existing common guard is appropriate implementation, but preparation-stage witnesses cannot stand in for the explicitly required consumer trajectory, particularly its post-lock lease recheck.
findings.requested_change: Extend the existing own-namespace suite with actual fully prepared S36/S37-to-COMMIT_READY denials for current-manifest replacement, attempt loss, stale fence/takeover and lease expiry. Establish valid ingress and the intended current-state denial, use a bounded observed lock blocker for post-lock lease expiry, and compare exact persisted state including receipt/event/outbox and stage/pointers. Preserve owner-generated immutable outputs and existing fixtures. Rerun every required check and obtain fresh SHA-bound reviews.
